notes.title: A TALE OF PAPER IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]There's nothing 'tearable' about this news – A Tale of Paper: Refolded has officially launched and is available to download now![/b][/h3]

The world can be a dangerous place for a little paper person, but luckily you're much more than an average sheet of A4. Imbued with magic, you can change into a variety of different papery forms, each with their own special abilities that will help you overcome the challenges ahead. 

[previewyoutube=SYMcrQpGT-c;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] If you play A Tale of Paper: Refolded and would like to leave some feedback, go ahead and drop it here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1454640/discussions/0/3437955554620964745/][b]A Tale of Paper: Refolded | Game Feedback[/b][/url]
[*] If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please report them in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1454640/discussions/0/3437955554620982969/][b]A Tale of Paper: Refolded | Bug Reports[/b][/url]
[*] A Tale of Paper: Refolded has also launched on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S (and will be coming later in the year to PS5 and Switch)
[*] If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a user review. Every review really helps!
[/list]
Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy A Tale of Paper: Refolded!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Digerati][b]Matt | Digerati[/b][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454640/A_Tale_of_Paper_Refolded/

notes.title: RELEASE DATE AND NEW TRAILER!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Exciting news – A Tale of Paper: Refolded will be launching on Steam (and other PC storefronts + Xbox) on 19th August. If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and you'll receive a reminder on launch day as soon as it's available.[/b]

To celebrate the release date announcement, we've put together a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=SYMcrQpGT-c;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for the support and we can't wait for you to experience A Tale of Paper: Refolded when it launches in just a few weeks!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Digerati]Matt | Digerati[/url][/b]

notes.title: DEMO! TRAILER! NEWS!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to tell you that A Tale of Paper demo is available to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454640/A_Tale_of_Paper/]download now from the store page[/url][/b]! It features the opening two levels, introduces a couple of the shape-shifting abilities, and eases you into things with some gentle challenges to figure out.

We've also got a new trailer to share – which you can watch below! – and the news that Digerati is the game's official publisher!
[previewyoutube=DGitb93a6Hk;full][/previewyoutube]
A Tale of Paper is part of the Future Games Show along with a quality selection of other titles that are well worth checking out. You can find the entire selection on the event page: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FutureGamesShow]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FutureGamesShow[/url][/b]

Have fun with the demo, and we look forward to sharing more with you soon!

Matt | Digerati
